_notes:
ams AS5600 12-bit magnetic rotary position sensor at 0x36 (fixed; the AS5600L is a separate part at 0x40). It has no ID register, so detection checks bits the datasheet defines as 0: ZMCO (0x00) bits 7:2, CONF (0x07) bits 7:6, STATUS (0x0B) bits 7:6, and the top nibble of the 12-bit RAW ANGLE (0x0C), ANGLE (0x0E) and MAGNITUDE (0x1B). The MAX17048 at 0x36 fails it (its 0x0C CONFIG reads 0x971C)
No init: the defaults (ZPOS, MPOS and MANG 0 - the full 360 degrees - and CONF 0) are used; the programming registers and BURN (0xFF) are never written
Poll (100 ms): ANGLE (0x0E-0x0F), STATUS (0x0B) and AGC with MAGNITUDE (0x1A-0x1C). magnet is STATUS MD (a magnet detected), tooWeak and tooStrong are ML and MH (too far or too close: the AGC at its limit). The angle is only valid with magnet set and tooWeak and tooStrong clear. AGC runs 0-255 at 5 V and 0-128 at 3.3 V; it is mid-range with the magnet at the right distance
Source: registers from the ams AS5600 datasheet

rsao.note: bench (Axiom018, 2026-10-27): 0x99 is past the register map (0x00-0x1C, BURN 0xFF) and the read returns zeros. ZMCO, ZPOS, MPOS, MANG and CONF (0x00-0x08) and STATUS unchanged, and it stayed identified. A lone byte writes nothing, so it can't reach BURN, which needs a data byte. 0x36 is in Axiom's RSAO check range (not excluded) and isn't a tier address
